reviewText: A hotel of this status needs to provide better inclusive ammenities for guests…like a basic coffee machine (you can purchase alcohol everywhere but a basic espresso is difficult to find) why not include resort fees… a single price whether high or low is understood. Add-ons like ‘resort fees’ feel like a money grab, especially since the gym is temporary and the beautiful resort pools are part of the allure.

# Bellagio review (Expedia)

**Rating:** 4/10 ★★☆☆☆
**Travelling as:** Partner, Family
**Sub-ratings:** Cleanliness: 10; Service: 6; Hotel condition: 6; Amenities: 6

## Review
A hotel of this status needs to provide better inclusive ammenities for guests…like a basic coffee machine (you can purchase alcohol everywhere but a basic espresso is difficult to find) why not include resort fees… a single price whether high or low is understood. Add-ons like ‘resort fees’ feel like a money grab, especially since the gym is temporary and the beautiful resort pools are part of the allure.
